result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational tone in first-person plural, with broad claims such as 'we're really just getting started'. Science, research and patients lead the framing. Ethics & compliance is a dedicated, structured section. Much of the page is recognition, scale and an acquisition disclaimer, which is chrome or business description. Commitments are mostly stated absolutely.
